candidates.reason: This is the original leaderboard strip pasted at the same size into the middle of the canvas. About 70% of it is empty cream band above and below. The text stays tiny, so nothing was rearranged for the new shape.

The pacewell logo is blown up to fill two-thirds of the canvas and dominates everything, so the hierarchy is wrong. The headline is pushed into a small strip at the bottom, the '4.8 STARS' badge is shrunk until it can't be read, and the CTA is a small afterthought jammed against the bottom-right edge.

The headline and CTA are large and strong and the canvas is used well. But the headline is indented about 160px from the logo's left edge, so the two don't share an edge. The badge and CTA have different heights and sit crowded together, and the CTA runs close to the bottom and right edges while the top-right is empty.

The structure is clean: the logo and headline share a left edge, and the badge sits above the CTA in a right-hand column. But all the content is squeezed into a middle band, leaving big empty areas at the top and bottom. The headline is too small for the canvas, and the badge is centred over the CTA instead of aligned to its edge.
